quality_requirements: Every scene must have a distinct narrative purpose.
The video must not be a single static image loop.
At least three visually distinct scene constructions are required.
Text must remain inside 9:16 safe zones.
No random zoom, arbitrary transition, or dashboard card construction.
The contextual photo must not be presented as a client, case study, or Mission GroundWork event.
The opening frame and closing frame must be legible without audio.
